unspecified.behavior: A page request now holds PYMUPDF_LOCK for its whole run, from the first page-count need through rendering up to 4 pages, instead of taking it once per PyMuPDF call.

scores.reason: An extraction or OCR that starts while a page request runs waits a few seconds more for the lock. The user sees nothing.

When a vision-capable profile asks for PDF page images while an extraction is running, the extraction or the page request waits a few seconds longer for the shared lock (the page request gives up after 30 s and the page is named not available); the user sees nothing beyond a slight delay.

counted.reason: When a vision-capable profile asks for PDF page images while an extraction is running, the extraction or the page request waits a few seconds longer for the shared lock (the page request gives up after 30 s and the page is named not available); the user sees nothing beyond a slight delay.
